summary_page.headline: Priced where recent sales support, for the strongest first weeks on the market.
why: The closest sales nearby, adjusted to your home, center near the middle of the range.
The market has cooled: buyers negotiate, and many sellers help with buyer costs.
Well-priced homes nearby are selling; overpriced ones are sitting.
summary_page.next_step: Review this plan together, sign the listing agreement, and get the home ready to go live.

recommendation.why: It leaves room for the negotiating that is normal now and presents the home as fairly priced in its first weeks, when buyer attention is highest.

means: Expect to negotiate. Recent buyers nearby paid less than the original asking price and most asked the seller to cover part of their closing costs. Plan for both from the start.

The first three weeks matter most. A new listing gets its biggest wave of showings right away. Priced where buyers expect, that wave turns into offers; priced high, the home sits and the price cut comes later, from a weaker position.
Watch the appraisal. A contract well above the supported range would risk a low appraisal, because the appraiser works from the same sales.

Documentation is worth money. The permitted roof and AC are among the most valuable facts in the listing, because roof age decides whether a buyer can insure the home. Have the permits and final inspections ready on day one.

prep.intro: These steps cost little and remove the questions that slow Florida buyers down or cost sellers money at the negotiating table.

items.short: Permits and final inspections, ready to share

items.step: Get a four-point and wind-mitigation report
items.detail: Buyers can get insurance quotes before they offer. With original single-pane windows, the wind-mitigation report shows exactly what credits the roof earns.
items.short: Lets buyers price insurance before they offer

items.detail: The electrical permit plus invoices for the cabinets, counters and appliances.

items.short: Learn about any issue before a buyer does

items.step: Decide on a seller-credit budget now
items.detail: Most recent sales included one. A credit toward a rate buydown lowers a buyer's payment more in the first years than the same amount off the price.
items.short: Decide it now, before offers arrive

items.detail: If there are steady showings but no offer after about three weeks, we revisit the price with fresh data rather than waiting.
